Commentary.Commentary: The chase is set to begin. Pakistan players stride out to the middle. Followed by Philip Salt and Alex Hales who walk out to open for England. Naseem Shah to start with the new ball.
... The Run Chase ...

Now the target is a tricky one, there is turn and grip in the surface but the boundaris are small. England need to make use of the new ball, if they do manage to score against that, it could get a lot easier for them to chase this down. If that does not happen, it could be a tough chase for them.

For England, their bowlers did not adjust to the conditions first up but as the game progressed, they understood what to bowl here. A lot of off pace deliveries were delivered and they made it run-scoring tough. Luke Wood was brilliant and so was Rashid. Willey and Curran came back strongly later on and Richard Gleeson and Moeen Ali did well too.

Coming to what happened now, the start was excellent for Pakistan. The openers really enjoyed batting against the new ball and they added 85. Rizwan was the aggressor and Azam played along his merry way. Once the skipper fell, runs were hard to come by. Only Rizwan managed to score freely but the rest really struggled. Iftikhar Ahmed did strike a few meaty blows but Pakistan did not get the finish they would have liked.

That is a terrific comeback from England you can see, they are pretty happy as they walk off! Pakistan just could not get going in the second half and they only managed around 70 runs in the last 10 overs. Now that could either mean, the wicket just got slower or Pakistan batted really poorly. However, they do have a score on the board so we could be in for an exciting second half.
Full length, on off. Shah drills it to long on for a single. Pakistan end their innings at 158/7.
Length, on off, pushed out.
Usman Qadir is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! Luke Wood picks up third wicket on his debut. A dream start for him. It is short, on the body. Shah pulls it to deep square leg. Sam Curran charges towards the ball and takes a sharp catch diving forward.
Commentary.Howout: c Sam Curran b Luke Wood

Commentary.Commentary: This is lofted to long off for one.

OUT! CAUGHT! Iftikhar Ahmed thought he got any biggie but Ben Duckett thought otherwise. A low full toss, on the body line. Ahmed slogs it to deep mid-wicket. This was in the air for a long time but Ben Duckett does well to pluck it out of thin air. Naseem Shah is the new man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Ben Duckett b Luke Wood

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! This is out of here! Ahmed is putting some life in this crowd! It is a cutter, outside off. Ahmed hangs back and smacks it over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Ahmed mistimes his pull towards mid-wicket. They only take a single.
This is full, angled across, outside off. It stays low. Ahmed looks to hit it square on the off side but gets an inside edge into the deck.
Back of a length, wide of off. Shah plays it over covers. They take a single.
A dot now! Swing and a miss! Slower ball, outside off. Shah looks to chase it but misses.
Fuller, angled down leg. Ahmed flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
SIX! BANG! This gets the crowd going. A short ball, on the bodyline. Iftikhar Ahmed hangs back and smokes it over the square leg fence for a biggie.
Length ball, outside off. Ahmed punches it to point for a single. A wicket and just four runs off it. England have done really well to pull things back.
Wood fires in a yorker this time, around off. Ahmed digs it out watchfully.
On a length, outside off. Shah taps it to point for a single.
Fuller, wide of off. Ahmed works it to sweeper cover for a single.
Wood goes full, outside off. Shah pushes it to mid off for one.

OUT! TIMBER! What a way to get your first international wicket. Luke Wood is delighted. It is a full-length ball, around off, it nips in a bit. Mohammad Nawaz tries to heave it across the line but misses it completely. The ball goes through and uproots the off stump. Half of side back in the hut for Pakistan. Khushdil Shah is the new batter in.
Full, on the pads, Nawaz flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Another wide! Down the leg side yet again. Nawaz looks to flick but misses.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Fuller. Wided.
A yorker on off, this is hit down to long off for one.
Superb fielding! Saves three for his side. Shorter and outside off, Nawaz looks to guide it past point. The fielder dives to his right and saves it.
Goes short now and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
SIX! BANG! That is a massive hit! Length and on middle, Ahmed stands tall and sends it sailing over the long on fence. Needed that did Pakistan.
Runs just very hard to come by now! On middle, a slower one. It is played back to the bowler.
Loops it up, on off. Nawaz comes down the track and inside-edges it on the pads.
Fuller, outside off. Nawaz gets low and sweeps it to deep square leg. Luke Wood does well in the deep to keep it down to just two runs.
Tossed up, around off. Ahmed goes back and punches it to long on for a single.
A bit lucky this time! A googly this time. Ahmed fails to pick it up. It takes the inside edge and goes down to fine leg. They take two.
On off, defended out.

OUT! CAUGHT! Adil Rashid gets his second wicket. It is tossed up, around off. Masood goes for the reverse sweep. The ball lobs off the top-edge towards short third. Richard Gleeson there takes a dolly. Shan Masood trudges back to the pavilion. Mohammad Nawaz is the new man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Richard Gleeson b Adil Rashid

Commentary.Commentary: Another single! On middle, Masood looks to play the slog sweep but this goes off the bottom edge towards mid-wicket for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.

WIDE! Not sure what happened there! Maybe because the umpire had signaled wide, the ball was dead or else, it would have been taken upstairs. This is very wide outside off. Left alone. Salt waits for a bit and then whips the bails off. He appeals. The umpires get together and have a word and then decide the ball was dead before the bails were knocked off. Also, replays show that Iftikhar Ahmed was in.

Is that stumped? Philip Salt is confident. The square leg umpire has a chat but they do not go take it upstairs as they think nothing happened. The back foot seems to be grounded and the third umpire does not get involved.
Iftikhar Ahmed comes in at number 5.

OUT! STUMPED! Ali gets the big fish, the well-set Rizwan is out of here now! He steps out and Moeen Ali spots it. He fires it shorter and outside off. Rizwan is beaten for pace as he looks to flick. It goes to the keeper who does the rest. England right back into the game now. They can keep Pakistan below the 180-run mark.
Commentary.Howout: st Philip Salt b Moeen Ali

Commentary.Commentary: Two more! Rizwan walks across and sweeps this wide of long on for two.
Now a single as it is hit down to long on.
FOUR! That has raced away! Masood makes room, this is fuller and on off, it is lofted over cover for a boundary.
Masood is off the mark! Outside off, this is pushed through cover for one. Back-to-back good overs for England.

Masood is not hanging around here! He makes room, this is shorter and outside off. Masood looks to cut but underedges it towards the keeper. Another dot. This is another top over for England. Can he end it well though?
Really don't think there was a single on there! This is fuller and tailing back in. Masood looks to flick but it goes off the inner half on the leg side. Masood wanted one but is sent back.
Shan Masood is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Haider Ali's return is not a good one! Curran gets a wicket and the good passage of play continues for England! A slower one, on middle, Ali looks to heave it over the mid-wicket fence but due to the lack of pace on the wicket, it goes more off the toe-end and it is an easy catch for the fielder there.
Commentary.Howout: c David Willey b Sam Curran

Commentary.Commentary: Goes into the surface again, short and well outside off, Rizwan slaps it through covers for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Yes, he does! A really good over from Willey! A full toss to end but it is only flicked through mid-wicket for one.
Rizwan walks down the track, this is banged in short and outside off. Rizwan drags it through mid-wicket for one. Can Willey end the over well now?
Three dots in a row! A low full toss, Rizwan drives but to covers. Willey is going really full here. He knows that is the best length on this wicket.
Another yorker, Rizwan looks to jam it out and run but is sent back.
On middle, a yorker, it is jammed back to the bowler. A dot, quite rare.
On middle, a slower one, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On off, Haider works it towards the leg side and takes one.
Now looks to sweep again but this is bowled slower and outside off, it goes off the underedge through square leg for one.
SIX! That is a massive hit! A little too straight and a little too full from Rashid. The slog sweep comes out and it sails over the mid-wicket fence.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On the stumps, this is worked through mid-wicket for one more.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
Another single! On middle, Ali works it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end. Tidy from Richard Gleeson!
A slower short one and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
A short one, on the body, a slower short one. Ali pulls it towards fine leg for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for a single.
On off, this is pushed through cover for one more.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.

Drinks break! Well, the scoreline reads 87/1 and that tells you that the bowlers have been made to toil hard. Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan built a solid foundation, just like the usualy, Rizwan raced to his fifty but Azam had to walk out just before the drinks break. This is a crucial breakthrough for England and they would hope that they can make the most of it.
A dot to end a successful over for Pakistan! On the pads, this is worked to short fine leg.
Two to get off the mark! A little too full this time, this is driven through covers for a couple.
The leg spinner now, this lands outside off and spins away. Haider looks to drive but it goes off the outer half to point.
Haider Ali walks out at number 3.

OUT! TIMBER! The googly does the trick and Babar Azam walks back! That is a beauty! Azam had absolutely no idea about it! This lands outside off, it turns back in. Azam just does not pick it. He looks to cover for the spin towards the end but this one sneaks through the gap between bat and pad and hits the middle stump. Rashid does what he has been doing throughout his career, provide the breakthrough and a much-needed one.
Two more! On middle, this is worked with soft hands on the leg side for two.
Tossed up outside off, this is hit to cover.
Two more! End of a very expensive over from Ali! On middle, Rizwan works it between long on and mid-wicket and takes two.
SIX! First of the game! Slammed down the ground! Rizwan steps out, he gets to the pitch of the ball and hits it over the long on fence for a biggie. Rizwan gets his fifty in some style.
Outside off, this is guided towards short third man for one.
Fumble but only one! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and outside off, this is dragged wide of long on for two.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Top edge but safe! On middle, Rizwan looks to sweep, this goes off the top edge towards fine leg for two.
Another single as this is flicked through mid-wicket.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Some turn! The googly, it lands on middle and turns back in. Rizwan works it to short fine leg.
Another single as this is pushed through mid-wicket.
WIDE! Pushes this one through but down the leg side. Wided.
Tossed up outside off, this is hit down to long on for one.
A single to end! On middle, this is worked through square leg for one. A top over for Pakistan.

FOUR! Rizwan is in the mood here! Rizwan makes room, this is fuller and on middle, it is pushed down the ground to the long off fence. This was a mere push, saw mid off was up and just timed it past him.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
A slower one and on the pads, this is clipped through square leg for one.
FOUR! That is brilliant placement! Shorter and on the body, Rizwan was followed as he made room. He pulls it through backward square leg and it races away to the fence.
A slower one on middle, Azam works it through mid-wicket for a single.

Two more! Decent comeback by Wood after going for a boundary first up! End of the Powerplay and Pakistan are 51 for 0 after it. Good start for them again! A full toss on middle, this is worked through square leg for a couple.
Another quick run! Length and on off, Azam pushes it towards mid off for a quick run.
Fuller and on middle, Azam strokes it back to the bowler. Another dot.
Shorter and on middle, this one skids through. Rizwan looks to pull, it goes off the inner half through square leg for one.
This one stays a touch low! On the pads, Rizwan walks across and looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Rizwan wants a single as it rolls on the leg side. Not taken.
FOUR! Slammed down the ground! Rizwan steps out, he makes the ball into a half volley and smashes it down to the long off fence. A good start to the 6th.
Fuller, outside off, Azam looks to chase it but misses. 7 runs off the over.
Length, on middle and leg. Rizwan clips it towards long on and crosses for a single now.
FOUR! Nicely played! Fuller, angled into the pads. Rizwan stays back and flicks it through mid-wicket. It goes along the ground to the boundary.
Length, outside off. Azam drives it through covers and rotates the strike.
This is on a length, tucking into the pads. Rizwan flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Gleeson starts with a short ball, outside off. Rizwan looks to cut it away but misses. Good pace on this one.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Rizwan works it to mid on for a single. A tidy over by Wood comes to an end.

A loud appeal for lbw but turned down! Luke Wood has a chat with his skipper but Moeen Ali shows no interest. It is a length ball, angled across, around off. Rizwan looks to whip it away but misses. He gets rapped on his pads. The umpire though shows no interest. Might've been pitching outside leg.
Another single now, as Azam clips it off his pads to square leg.
Wood goes full, outside off. Rizwan strokes it to mid off and crosses for a single.
This is flicked through the leg side for a single.
Brilliant fielding! A length ball, outside off. Azam drives it to the right of covers. The fielder there moves to that side and stops the ball with one hand.
This is pulled to mid-wicket for a single. A great over for Pakistan, 17 runs off it.

FOUR! Pure timing! Azam joins the party as well. Good length, angled across the right-hander, outside off. Azam stands tall and punches it past extra covers. The outfield helps the ball reach the rope in a flash.
Fuller, on the pads, Rizwan nurdles it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries now! Short again, down leg. Rizwan helps it around the corner. The fine leg is in and the ball races away to the boundary.
FOUR! Width on offer and punished. Short and wide of off. Rizwan hangs back and cuts it through cover-point. It races away.

One-handed shot! A length ball, on fourth stump. Azam goes for the off drive as his bottom hands comes off it. The ball evades Alex Hales at extra covers. He chases it, puts in a dive near the ropes and saves the boundary. Three taken.
Length, wide of off, angled across. Azam punches it to sweeper cover and gets a single this time. This over started well but Pakistan got 6 off it.
FOUR! The crowd roars as the ball crosses the ropes. Back of a length, drifting down leg. Azam stays back and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Rizwan is able to rotate the strike here. A length ball, on off. Rizwan pushes it gently towards point and crosses.
Full length, outside off. Rizwan drives it to extra covers. Three dots now!

Two dots in a row now! A moment of indecision between the two batters now. A length ball, on off. Rizwan taps it to point. Azam calls for a single but Rizwan denies and rightly so, as the fielder was a bit closer to the ball this time.
A dot now! Fuller in length, angled across the right-hander. Rizwan leans forward and pushes it to mid on.
Sam Curran to share the new ball.
Length, on the pads, Rizwan tucks it to mid-wicket for another single. Not a single dot ball in the over. A positive start from Pakistan, 9 runs off it.
Incredible running! Good-length ball, on off. Azam hangs back and taps it to point. The ball goes straight to the fielder but still these two batters manage to sneak a single.
Length, on off. Rizwan guides it to deep point and crosses for a single.
Good length, around off. Azam bunts it to the off side. Azam hesitates for the single but Rizwan calls for it and makes it to the other ends in a flash.
FOUR! Azam though gets off the mark in fine manner. It is fuller, too straight on the pads. Azam clips it through square leg and finds the boundary.
Mohammad Rizwan and Pakistan are off the mark. It is fuller, outside off. Rizwan leans in and drives it to sweeper cover for a single.

Done with all the pre-match proceedings! England players stride out to the middle. Followed by Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan who walk out to open for Pakistan. It will be David Willey to start with the new ball. Here we go...

Both the teams make their way out on the field. They will pay tribute to the passing of Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II and for the floods in Pakistan recently by following a minute's silence. It will be followed by a rendition of God Save the King, then the Pakistan's national anthem.

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Babar Azam (C), Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Haider Ali, Shan Masood (On T20I debut), Iftikhar Ahmed, Khushdil Shah, Mohammad Nawaz, Usman Qadir, Haris Rauf, Naseem Shah, Shahnawaz Dahani.
England (Playing XI) - Philip Salt (WK), Alex Hales, Dawid Malan, Ben Duckett, Harry Brook, Moeen Ali (C), Sam Curran, David Willey, Luke Wood (On T20I Debut), Adil Rashid, Richard Gleeson.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of England. They will BOWL first.

Pakistan on the other hand, will want to get their combination right for the World Cup. There are a few new names in their squad and some of them are making a come back. Shan Masood finally gets a chance. Aamer Jamal is a very exciting prospect and Abrar Ahmed can be an x-factor for them. They’ll be eager to put the loss in the final of the Asia Cup 2022 behind and start this series with a win.
